item.title: todo-fp-map, or Spain's vocational training cycles on a map with SQLite in the browser
item.description: After years at CARTO I never lost the itch to make little maps. 4,646 vocational training centers geocoded into SQLite, served straight to the browser with sql.js in a Web Worker, no backend: map, facets, and Datasette Lite for free-form queries.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
